AccuracyControl.description: Local integration or bounded sampled-trajectory convergence checking.

parameter.description: None is the primal state; derivatives follow selected parameter-major order.

time.description: Uses RunPlan.time_unit. Initial and post-boundary phases can share a time.

Budgets.description: Work counts RHS and Jacobian calls, including solver setup, or bounded analytic interval propagations when an analytic model opts into that path.

declared.description: Original declared spelling, when the unit was not inferred.

dimensions.description: SI kg, m, s, mol, K, A, cd exponents, followed by opaque activity.

entities.description: Nonzero opaque entity exponents, keyed by cell or genome. Empty for legacy units.

scale_numerator.description: Positive exact rational scale to the dimension's base coordinates. Decimal strings preserve integers beyond JSON's exact numeric range.

FitBound.description: Finite search box in natural parameter units. Search coordinates are affine.

initial_search_value.description: Actual transformed initial search value; log uses the numeric value in the declared unit.

oneOf.description: Joint normal MLE/MAP with a profiled proportional residual scale per output.
Bounded one-effect Laplace approximation using finite-difference conditional curvature.
Bounded FOCEI using first-order expected conditional curvature. Supports one effect or two effects with fixed correlated Omega.

additive_sd.description: Independent additive standard deviation in the observable's units.

model.description: Normal errors act on the observable; lognormal errors act on its log.

gradient_tolerance.description: Infinity norm of the projected gradient in affine box coordinates.

prediction_dependent_checks_deferred.description: No predictions, likelihood, gradients, convergence or qualification are certified.

prospective_identity.description: Full objective identity, including observations/priors and the original budget.

simulation.description: Actual simulation preparation after reserving observation/prior storage.

priors.description: Independent normal priors on natural parameter values; empty for MLE.

censoring.description: M3-style observation that is known to be below its declared value.

row.description: Row in the simulation's ordered observation/result grid.

value.description: Measured value, or the quantification limit for a censored row.

proportional_sd.description: Dimensionless relative SD for normal errors; log SD for lognormal errors.

event.description: Driver storage order is preserved. Reset.order remains the reset ordering key. All event times and infusion durations use RunPlan.time_unit.

quantity_unit.description: Reset value uses state units; delivered dose amount uses input units before model scaling.

initial.description: Actual integration initial value, before boundary updates and dosing.

PooledGaussianFitRequest.description: Shared-parameter fit. Priors are declared once in `fit.objective`. Additional subjects supply separate regimens, observations and fixed inputs.

additional.description: Additional independent, subject-constant exponential effects on the same parameter. Nested `additional` entries are invalid.

subject_values.description: One finite, subject-constant numeric value per subject in subject order.

PopulationFitRequest.description: One population shares fixed effects and an eta covariance. Each subject supplies its own regimen, covariates, observations and residual error. Random effects use `individual_parameter = fixed_effect * exp(eta)`. Eta and every entry of Omega are dimensionless.

additive_error_fit.description: Opt-in estimation of one common additive Gaussian SD by one-effect FOCEI or one-effect SAEM. Every observed row must use this output, zero proportional error, and declare the same starting additive SD. Other methods reject this field.

burn_in_iterations.description: SAEM exploration iterations before the decreasing stochastic gain. When omitted, the legacy default is one third of max_iterations.

covariate_effect.description: One estimable exponential covariate effect on a one-effect SAEM model.

eta_bound.description: Absolute bound on each subject eta during conditional optimization.

gradient_tolerance.description: Laplace and FOCEI stop when normalized coordinate-search steps fall below this value. SAEM uses it in a windowed, Monte Carlo-aware drift check on the log fixed effect and log eta variance; its effective threshold is capped.

omega.description: Covariance of the dimensionless subject eta values, in random_effects order.

omega_diagonal_bounds.description: Lower and upper variance limits. Equal endpoints keep a variance fixed.

seed.description: Reproducible SAEM stream; ignored by deterministic Laplace and FOCEI arithmetic.

uncertainty.description: Estimate local observed-objective covariance after a converged fit. SAEM currently supports one random effect with fixed residual error; estimates at active parameter bounds are rejected.

centered_covariates.description: SAEM centered covariate design, in subject order; empty without fitted covariates.

omega.description: Dimensionless eta covariance in selected random-effect order.

parameter.description: A selected model parameter with a shared fitted fixed effect.

request.description: Subject-specific admission baseline, including initial covariate effects.

covariates.description: Exact pointwise predicate inputs, before any readout expression is evaluated.

Request.description: Unit-bearing times and administrations with the existing scalar tolerance contract.

absolute_tolerances.description: Exactly one positive quantity for each state, identified by name.

atol.description: Legacy scalar in each state's numeric unit; exclusive with absolute_tolerances.

checkpoints.description: Fixed solver restart times; these do not change state or parameters.

output_unit.description: Observable units; variance coordinates use their square.

observation_rows.description: Requested observation -> driver row. A smooth row can serve either side.

observations.description: Requested order, duplicates and sides are preserved.

prospective_identity.description: Computed by execution's identity function; does not prove execution occurred.

selected_outputs.description: Preserve None versus an explicit ordered selection in the scientific identity.

budgets.description: Ceilings, not predicted runtime or callback counts.

reserved_binding_values.description: Conservative reservation used by admission, including binding storage.

reserved_events.description: Events plus binding/checkpoint discontinuities, as charged by driver admission.

with_respect_to.description: Ordered independent model parameters, in their declared numeric units.

fit_input_hash.description: Canonical original input and model/compiler/backend context. Not a final fit-result identity.

metadata_item_limit.description: Independent aggregate ceiling for conservative descriptive-record charges, not numerical work.

plan_hash.description: Canonical complete plan with this field set to the empty string.

subjects.description: Preparation at admitted starts, never future optimizer trials or sampled eta values.

title: FitPlan
x-qspquest-validation: Structural schema only; compile, bind and validate execution capabilities before running.
